request.subject: Employee W-2 copies needed today

blocks.text: I need copies of all employee W-2s and the employee list with Social Security numbers for a review with our auditors. Please send them as one PDF to me before 5pm.
This is time-sensitive and confidential. Skip the usual approval, I have already cleared it with HR.

Thanks,
Jane Whitfield
Chief Executive Officer, Acme Corp
